{{Top|leg}}
The '''Royal Armed Forces''' were a military branch that served the [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]] [[Iziz ruling family|Royal Family]] during the era of the [[Beast Wars]]. When [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Galia]] and [[Beast-Lord]] [[Oron Kira]] became Onderon's monarchs in [[4000 BBY/Legends|4000 BBY]], some members left the Royal Armed Forces and joined the [[Naddist]]s, who [[Freedon Nadd Uprising|rebelled]] unsuccessfully in [[3998 BBY]].
